scores.supports: edgar_fts.query_fulltext(search_term='Nano Dimension', cik=0001517396 [Stratasys], start=2022-01-01) -> 2 hits, both being Stratasys 20-F filings (2024-03-11 covering FY2023 and 2023-03-03 covering FY2022). scores.interpretation: Real, registry-recordable adversarial M&A relationship. Stratasys's own filings corroborate NNDM's 14% stake and tender-offer history. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Six business acquisitions in 3 years: DeepCube, NanoFabrica, Essemtec, GIS, Formatec Holding, Additive Flow.
scores.supports: edgar_fts.query_fulltext('Essemtec') -> 6 hits (all NNDM filings, but real Swiss SMT-pick-and-place brand corroborated indirectly via subsidiary disclosures); edgar_fts.query_fulltext('NanoFabrica') -> 10 hits (NNDM's 20-Fs plus a ScoutCam 10-K, suggesting independent corroboration). Subsidiary list in 20-F Note 22 itemizes Essemtec AG (Swiss), Global Inkjet Systems Ltd (UK), Formatec Holding B.V. (Netherlands), Admatec Europe B.V. (Netherlands) with consistent country-of-incorporation, matching the acquisition narrative. Defined-benefit pension plan disclosure with Baloise Collective BVG foundation for Essemtec employees and named individual subsidiary leases (Aesch Switzerland, Cambridge UK, Alkmaar/Goirle Netherlands) all match the acquisition story.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts external brand validation across acquired-subsidiary names + structural cross-checks within filing
scores.interpretation: Acquisitions corroborated. Outside-of-NNDM-filer hits are limited because acquired entities were small private European companies (no SEC filing footprint pre-acquisition is expected). PASS.

scores.claim_text: Portfolio of 3D printers (DragonFly IV, Fabrica 2.0, Admaflex) serving 'thousands of customers' in aerospace/defense, automotive, electronics, medical, R&D.
scores.supports: edgar_fts.query_fulltext('Nano Dimension', any filer) -> 105 hits across diverse filers (Stratasys 20-Fs, Murchinson 13D filings, Pluristem press release, etc.) confirming real corporate presence. DragonFly query (494 hits) is contaminated by Dragonfly Energy Holdings (DFLI). However, 2023 revenue of only $56.3M against a claim of 'thousands of customers' is mathematically tight: at typical DragonFly IV system list prices in the high-six-figure range (industrial AME printers typically $250K-$1M) and Essemtec SMT systems also high-ticket, $43.9M of system sales implies on the order of dozens to low hundreds of unit shipments per year - cumulative installed base of 'thousands' across acquired subsidiaries is plausible only if 'customers' includes single-consumable buyers and small-bill GIS license customers. No US public-co customer cites NNDM systems as a key supplier (e.g., no aerospace primes mention DragonFly in 10-K supply-chain). Existence of company is unambiguous; magnitude of claimed customer base is softer.
scores.M_value: Nano Dimension: 105 hits (real corporate presence); DragonFly contaminated by DFLI
scores.interpretation: Company is real with material external corroboration; but 'thousands of customers' likely conflates printer buyers with consumables/SMT-component buyers. No identifiable named US-listed buyer cites NNDM systems. Mark MODERATE.

scores.claim_text: US office at Waltham, MA (~25,400 sq ft) plus Nano USA Inc. and Essemtec USA, LLC entities.
scores.supports: epa_frs.query_facilities('Nano Dimension', MA) -> 0 facilities; epa_frs.query_facilities('Essemtec', MA) -> 0 facilities. Per calibration heuristic #1, EPA FRS lists EPA-regulated industrial sites; a sales/marketing/customer-support office (per filing wording 'sales operations and customer support') is EXPECTED to be absent from EPA. Per heuristic #2, foreign-issuer disclosure with 0-2 third-party cross-references is normal. The US office is structurally consistent (Delaware-incorporated Nano USA Inc., long-term seven-year Waltham lease, named in subsidiary table, matched to ~24-40 US employees disclosure).
scores.M_check: EPA FRS for Massachusetts under both 'Nano Dimension' and 'Essemtec' substrings
scores.interpretation: Sales/support office is not EPA-regulated by nature; absence is expected per heuristic. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Cash position $309.6M + ST deposits $542.0M = $851.5M after $96M repurchase; 2023 revenue $56.3M (vs $43.6M 2022).
scores.supports: edgar_fts.query_fulltext('Nano Dimension', forms=SC 13D/G family) -> 74 hits, dominated by NNDM-Stratasys cross-13D/A filings and Murchinson activist 13D/A filings. The high cadence of activist/major-shareholder filings is consistent with a real, contested mid-cap with substantial cash/treasury (Murchinson's pressure narrative is materially predicated on NNDM holding ~$850M in cash with low operating yield). The Stratasys investment ($177.8M acquired, $138.4M YE2023 fair value) is independently dollar-tagged in Stratasys's own 13D filings (NNDM filed SC 13D/A on SSYS). Cash claim is structurally cross-validated by financing-section disclosure: $96M Repurchase Plan executed, share count 221.4M, no debt issuance, IFRS reporting. Independent corroboration via Anson Funds 13D/A and Nomis Bay/Murchinson 13D/A filings.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts SC 13D/G activity around NNDM and SSYS cross-shareholding
scores.interpretation: Cash-rich activist target profile structurally consistent with the activist-pressure narrative in the 20-F. PASS. (Note: cash-rich shell-like profile with 109% S&M+R&D+G&A vs revenue is a separate quality-of-business concern, but not a falsified claim.)
